free_tier.stated: Still trading, but the reason to record it is a data-loss incident rather than a price: several Los Angeles host nodes were compromised through a Virtualizor vulnerability, the boot sectors of affected guest disks were overwritten with a ransom note, and the vendor states that the data on those disks cannot be recovered. The vendor's own wording, reposted in the forum: 攻击者损坏了与VPS相关的磁盘，磁盘上的数据无法恢复.

interface_detail: REST API and SSH, per the CloudCone API page: "CloudCone REST API allows you to access most of the features available at app.cloudcone.com", and per the VPS page: "Use the recovery mode to gain direct access via SSH."

chaining: This is the reason any free or cheap host in this lane needs a second copy elsewhere: the composition that survives an incident is two providers plus an object store, not one provider plus its own snapshots.
limits_note: What fails is durability: a hypervisor-level compromise destroyed guest disks across several nodes and the vendor confirmed non-recovery, so a snapshot kept on the same provider is not a backup.
